title: Null dereference in Necko HTTP channel during background DNS resolution timeout
raw_content: When an HTTP connection request encounters a DNS resolution timeout while the tab is being closed, nsHttpChannel::OnStopRequest dereferences a null mDNSTask pointer causing a crash in xul.dll with EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION.

title: Database connection pool exhaustion and socket timeout under concurrent read repair
raw_content: Native transport connection worker pool saturates when background read repair tasks stall on unresponsive nodes. New client CQL connections time out with NoHostAvailableException / ConnectionTimeoutException after reaching max connection pool ceiling.

title: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space during FST index terms dictionary construction with long terms
raw_content: Compiling finite state transducers for terms dictionaries exceeding 10M unique tokens triggers heavy 32-bit array allocations in PositiveIntOutputs, crashing JVM with OutOfMemoryError.

title: JWT Bearer authentication filter rejects valid authorization header on header case variation
raw_content: OAuth2 Bearer token authenticator checks Authorization header using case-sensitive lookup. Client proxies sending 'authorization' (lowercase) trigger 401 Unauthorized / TokenMissingException.

title: SocketTimeoutException not handled during chunked HTTP/1.1 response streaming
raw_content: When reading long chunked streams from reverse proxies, socket read timeouts cause ChunkedInputStream to leave connection socket in DIRTY state instead of releasing lease back to PoolingHttpClientConnectionManager.

title: NullPointerException in payment gateway during guest checkout
raw_content:

title: Minor cosmetic typo in user profile settings navigation header
raw_content: The word 'Preferences' is misspelled as 'Preferencs' on the top navbar layout. Cosmetic styling typo, non-blocking warning.

title: API rate limit warning emitted when syncing contacts intermittently
raw_content: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit quota exceeded for endpoint /v1/contacts. Client received retry-after header: 30 seconds.

title: Deadlock detected during simultaneous inventory reservation and warehouse sync
raw_content: Fatal deadlock: Transaction (Process ID 82) was deadlocked on lock resources with another process and has been chosen as the deadlock victim. Rerun the transaction.

title: Deprecated API warning in legacy report export module
raw_content: [WARN] Deprecation notice: FileExporter.exportToCSV() is deprecated since v2.4 and will be removed in v3.0. Use StreamExporter instead.
